risk: Loss of containment at the gas metering skid
current_assumption: A seal change on the meter is routine maintenance with no risk of its own.
evidence_says: The same meter had its gasket changed in February 2019 and September 2019, and the joint leaked again within a year [EVD-1494]; the malfunction notification raised in September 2020 was not closed after the job [EVD-0591]. The recurrence was never assessed as a risk.
proposed_change: Add repeat seal failure on ageing pressure-boundary equipment as a threat to this risk, with the reliability review that should follow a second failure as its control.

risk: Escalation of a major hydrocarbon release
current_assumption: Emergency isolation valves can be reached and closed by hand during a release.
evidence_says: The isolation valves had no remote operation from the control room [EVD-3932]; the shift in-charge had to reach the gas terminal gate before the first valve was closed, 46 minutes after first detection [EVD-9612].
proposed_change: Add a vapour cloud that denies access to manual isolation as a threat, and review whether remote or automatic isolation is needed as its control.

risk: Escalation of a major hydrocarbon release
current_assumption: Anyone who sees a release can warn the operating control room at once.
evidence_says: Perimeter security staff saw the vapour first but could tell only the CCTV control room and the main gate; the gas terminal control room heard of it after a further check by camera [EVD-6234] [EVD-8871].
proposed_change: Add an indirect warning path from the people most likely to see a release as a threat to early response.

current_assumption: Changes to plant and materials go through the management-of-change procedure published in August 2016.
evidence_says: The procedure was not followed for changes in 2013 and 2018, and no MOC had been carried out since 2018 [EVD-2986]; the seal substitution never reached a change review [EVD-8645].
proposed_change: Reassess the rating of the MOC control against its actual use since 2018, not against the existence of the procedure.

risk: Escalation of a major hydrocarbon release
current_assumption: The on-site disaster management plan and the ERDMP control the major-leak scenario.
evidence_says: Both documents named hydrocarbon leakage but neither gave isolation or stoppage criteria, nor who may decide to isolate [EVD-4052] [EVD-6414].
proposed_change: Revisit the rating of the emergency plan as a control for this scenario until it holds isolation criteria and the authority to act on them.

risk: Escalation of a major hydrocarbon release
current_assumption: Fixed gas detection protects the plant when a release occurs.
evidence_says: The detectors were wired to an annunciator for display only, with no automatic shutdown or fire suppression [EVD-8657] [EVD-3452].
proposed_change: Rate gas detection as an alarm that depends on people acting, not as an automatic protective control, and review the threats it is credited against.

current_assumption: Electrical equipment in the hazardous area keeps its flameproof protection.
evidence_says: A flameproof lamp had three bolts missing and its glass case open by 5 to 6 cm [EVD-6916]; electrical maintenance was skewed towards breakdowns, and the post-incident audit was one generic page [EVD-0496] [EVD-9999].
proposed_change: Reassess the rating of hazardous-area ignition control against inspection records for the fittings, not against the equipment's certification.

risk: Loss of containment from pipeline wall loss
current_assumption: Thickness surveys find wall loss and the findings are acted on.
evidence_says: The 2017 report found pipes needing corrective action, and three years later no plan existed [EVD-5527]; 1.03 mm of pitted wall loss on a segment with no corrosion allowance was treated with paint [EVD-2397].
proposed_change: Reassess the integrity control's rating on whether findings are closed, not on whether surveys are done.

current_assumption: The diesel fire-water pumps back up the electric pumps.
evidence_says: Of four diesel pumps, two were under maintenance, one ran for 30 minutes and one tripped after two minutes, with no cause found or action recorded [EVD-2432]. The electric pumps carried the incident.
proposed_change: Revisit the rating of the fire-water backup against the diesel pumps' recorded availability.

risk: Loss of containment at the gas metering skid
current_assumption: Parts on a hydrocarbon pressure boundary match the original specification, or a change is approved.
evidence_says: The original gasket specification was lost; locally bought O-rings were used as regular practice with no specification or quality check, and there is no record of the date or the authority of the decision to switch [EVD-8645].
proposed_change: Record the substitute seal as a risk carried without an approval, and ask the risk owner to decide whether it is accepted, changed or stopped.

risk: Open safety actions from the 2018 external audit
current_assumption: Audit actions are closed by their dates, or an extension is approved as the procedure requires.
evidence_says: 296 of 308 recommendations were complied with; the other 12 had dates extended to 30 April 2021 with no record of the approval the procedure requires [EVD-6852].
proposed_change: List each extended action as a risk carried without authority until the required approval is recorded or the action is closed.

risk: Loss of containment from pipeline wall loss
current_assumption: The four-year thickness-measurement cycle is kept.
evidence_says: The last two surveys were in 2011 and 2017, a six-year gap [EVD-8307], and baseline thickness data and pipe schedules were missing for many gas terminal pipes [EVD-8287].
proposed_change: Add an indicator of integrity inspections overdue against their cycle, reported with the risk.

current_assumption: Every hazardous job has a permit and a job safety plan on record.
evidence_says: Some work permits were missing with no record kept of them, and job safety plans were not attached in SAP [EVD-5105].
proposed_change: Add an indicator of permits not accounted for and jobs with no job safety plan, reported with the risk.
